topic: Amalgamation in the nature of merger
question: State the conditions that an amalgamation must satisfy to be an amalgamation in the nature of merger under AS 14 'Accounting for Amalgamations'. Which accounting method applies to each type of amalgamation?
keywords: amalgamation in the nature of merger
amalgamation in the nature of purchase
sources: AS 14 Accounting for Amalgamations - definitions and methods of accounting

points.label: All assets and liabilities transferred
points.description: All the assets and liabilities of the transferor company become those of the transferee company.
points.basis: AS 14, conditions for amalgamation in the nature of merger

points.label: 90 per cent shareholders
points.description: Shareholders holding at least 90 per cent of the face value of the transferor's equity shares (excluding shares already held by the transferee or its subsidiaries or their nominees) become equity shareholders of the transferee.
points.basis: AS 14, conditions for amalgamation in the nature of merger

points.label: Consideration in equity shares
points.description: The consideration to those equity shareholders is paid wholly by issue of equity shares of the transferee, except that cash may be paid for fractional shares.
points.basis: AS 14, conditions for amalgamation in the nature of merger

points.label: Business continued
points.description: The transferee intends to carry on the business of the transferor company.
points.basis: AS 14, conditions for amalgamation in the nature of merger

points.label: No change in book values
points.description: No adjustment is made to the book values of the transferor's assets and liabilities, except to make accounting policies uniform.
points.basis: AS 14, conditions for amalgamation in the nature of merger

points.label: Methods of accounting
points.description: An amalgamation meeting all the conditions is accounted for by the pooling of interests method; one that fails any condition is an amalgamation in the nature of purchase and uses the purchase method.
points.basis: AS 14, methods of accounting for amalgamations
